title: The status line is drawn in colour
body:
The status line under the prompt (`draw_status` and `status` in `header.rs`) draws almost everything in the muted colour. Only the mode value when the agent does not ask, a stop reason and hover get a colour. Jack wants more colour there, starting from a scheme he refines once he sees it.

## Proposal

| item | colour |
|---|---|
| mode value | `cyan`, or `yellow` when the agent does not ask |
| model | `blue`, muted during a turn |
| thought level | `magenta` |
| other settings | `muted` |
| separators | `muted` |
| `↑` and `↓` | `cyan` and `green`, numbers in the foreground colour |
| cost | `orange` |
| `plan n/m` | `yellow` while steps remain, `green` when done |
| `decade` | `cyan` |
| `<version> available` | `accent` |
| `idle` | `muted`, or `yellow` with a stop reason |

Hover stays `accent`. `Setting` in `settings.rs` needs to know whether it is the mode, the model, the thought level or another setting, from the config option's category.
close_reason: Landed in 7d5dc8e on `dev`, following the colour table in the body. A `Category` on `Setting` replaces the `model` and `rarely_changed` flags. A status `Item` holds spans so the token counts carry two colours.
